data.name: Benyamin
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, Benyamin is the name of one of the twelve sons of Prophet Jacob (as). He is known as the ‘son of the right hand’ or ‘son of the favored right hand’ because Jacob held him in his right hand during the prophetic blessing of his sons.
